title: GapAssessment
description: TOGAF-sourced justification archetype — Architecture Gap Assessment. Defines the property vocabulary for recording gaps between baseline (current) and target architecture states. Rootless archetype — used to type gap records in governance justification. TOGAF mapping: Gap Analysis (ADM Phases B/C/D — the technique of comparing baseline and target architectures to identify gaps using a disposition matrix). Source framework: TOGAF (Gap Analysis technique, ADM Phases B-D).

gapDisposition.description: How the gap is resolved in the gap analysis matrix. RETAINED = baseline component kept as-is in target. ENHANCED = baseline modified to meet target. NEW = target-only component with no baseline equivalent. ELIMINATED = baseline-only component to be removed. TOGAF mapping: Gap Analysis matrix disposition categories.

domain.description: TOGAF architecture domain in which the gap exists. Maps to the four core TOGAF architecture domains.

severity.description: Gap severity — drives prioritization in migration planning (ADM Phase F).

baselineDescription.description: Description of the current/baseline state for the component or capability.

targetDescription.description: Description of the desired target state for the component or capability.
